s2:The First Use of Positive and Unlabeled Machine Learning to Identify Fast Radio , 2023-10-06
s2:Population Modeling of Fast Radio Bursts from Source Properties, 2020-08-20

rationale: None of the candidate papers directly investigate why FRB 121102 is the only fast radio burst seen to repeat or what this implies about other FRBs. They discuss related topics such as FRB morphology, repetition rates, and statistical properties, but do not address the specific question.
